aboutGame.title: What Is World of Anterra?
paragraphs: World of Anterra is a handcrafted, open-world fantasy RPG by 81monkeys. Its non-linear story follows the Traveller through a world of ancient races, unstable magic, and the mystery of the Eye. Players can pursue quests, question characters, read books, and search the environment for secrets.

Combat combines strategic movement on a grid with timed attacks and defense, special abilities, spells, and crafted items. The announced adventure also features customizable party members, visible equipment, camping, dynamic weather, and day-night cycles. Steam currently lists the game as coming soon with a 2026 release window.

items.question: What is World of Anterra?
items.answer: World of Anterra is a handcrafted open-world RPG by 81monkeys. It features a non-linear story, exploration, party customization, and grid-based combat with quick-time actions.

items.question: When is World of Anterra releasing?
items.answer: The current Steam listing marks World of Anterra as coming soon and gives 2026 as its release window. It does not list a specific month or day.

items.question: Which platforms are listed for World of Anterra?
items.answer: Steam currently lists a Windows version of World of Anterra. The developer’s official site also describes the project as Desktop & Console without naming individual console models on its homepage.

items.question: How does combat work in World of Anterra?
items.answer: World of Anterra combines timed attacks and defense with strategic movement on a grid. The announced combat options include special abilities, magic spells, and crafted items.

items.question: Does World of Anterra support co-op?
items.answer: The World of Anterra Steam page lists online co-op, shared and split-screen co-op, and Remote Play Together alongside single-player. It does not specify how much of the campaign each mode covers.
